'''Binary Star Realty''' was a company that existed during the [[Galactic War]] that sold housing.

==Behind the scenes==
Binary Star Realty first appeared as part of the [[Cartel Market]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'', a expansion for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2014]].
